title: Another Bird Story
author: James Baldwin
summary: 一位将军在炮火中停下，把掉落的鸟巢放回树上。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1912 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: A great battle had begun. Cannon were booming, some far away, some near at hand. Soldiers were marching through the fields. Men on horseback were riding in haste toward the front.
paragraphs.zh: 一场大战开始了。大炮轰鸣，有的在远处，有的就在近旁。士兵们穿过田野行进，骑马的人匆匆奔向战场前线。

paragraphs.en: "Whiz!" A cannon ball struck the ground quite near to a company of soldiers. But they marched straight onward. The drums were beating, the fifes were playing.
paragraphs.zh: “嗖！”一颗炮弹落在离一队士兵很近的地上。但他们照直前进。鼓声咚咚，笛声阵阵。

paragraphs.en: "Whiz!" Another cannon ball flew through the air and struck a tree near by. A brave general was riding across the field. One ball after another came whizzing near him.
paragraphs.zh: “嗖！”又一颗炮弹飞过空中，击中了附近的一棵树。一位勇敢的将军正骑马穿过田野，一颗接一颗炮弹呼啸着从他身边掠过。

paragraphs.en: "General, you are in danger here," said an officer who was riding with him. "You had better fall back to a place of safety."
paragraphs.zh: “将军，您在这里太危险了，”和他并骑的军官说，“您最好退到安全的地方去。”

paragraphs.en: Suddenly he stopped at the foot of a tree. "Halt!" he cried to the men who were with him. He leaped from his horse. He stooped and picked up a bird's nest that had fallen upon the ground. In the nest were some tiny, half-fledged birds. Their mouths were open for the food they were expecting their mother to give them.
paragraphs.zh: 忽然，他在一棵树旁停下。“停！”他向随行的人喊道。他跳下马，弯腰捡起一个掉在地上的鸟巢。巢里有几只小小的、羽毛还没长全的雏鸟，它们张着嘴，等着母亲来喂食。

paragraphs.en: "I cannot think of leaving these little things here to be trampled upon," said the general.
paragraphs.zh: “我不能眼看着这些小东西留在这里被人踩死。”将军说。

paragraphs.en: He lifted the nest gently and put it in a safe place in the forks of the tree.
paragraphs.zh: 他轻轻托起鸟巢，把它放到树杈间一个安全的地方。

paragraphs.en: He leaped into the saddle, and away he dashed with his officers close behind him.
paragraphs.zh: 他跃上马鞍，疾驰而去，军官们紧紧跟在后面。

paragraphs.en: He had done one good deed. He would do many more before the war was over. "Boom! boom! boom!"
paragraphs.zh: 他做了一件善事。战争结束前，他还会做许多善事。“轰！轰！轰！”

paragraphs.en: The cannon were roaring, the balls were flying, the battle was raging. But amid all the turmoil and danger, the little birds chirped happily in the safe shelter where the great general, Robert E. Lee, had placed them. "He prayeth best, who loveth best All things both great and small; For the dear God who loveth us, He made and loveth all."
paragraphs.zh: 炮声怒吼，弹片横飞，战斗正酣。但在这一切混乱与危险之中，那几只小鸟却在大将军罗伯特·E. 李为它们安置的安全小巢里欢快地啁啾。“最懂得爱一切大小生灵的人，祈祷得最好；因为亲爱的上帝爱我们，他创造并爱着一切。”
